name: range_values
body:
Set src = ThisWorkbook
Set dst = Workbooks.Add
src.Worksheets(1).Range("A1").Value = 10
src.Worksheets(1).Range("B2").Value = 20
src.Worksheets(1).Range("A1:B2").Copy dst.Worksheets(1).Range("C3")
Report = CStr(dst.Worksheets.Count) & ":" & CStr(ActiveWorkbook Is dst) & "|"
For Each sh In dst.Worksheets
Report = Report & sh.Name & ":"
For Each cell In sh.Range("A1:D4")
If cell.Formula <> "" Then Report = Report & cell.Address & "=" & cell.Formula & ";"
Next cell
Report = Report & "|"
Next sh
For Each nm In dst.Names
Report = Report & nm.Name & "=" & nm.RefersTo & "|"
Next nm

name: sheet_names
body:
Set src = ThisWorkbook
Set dst = Workbooks.Add
src.Worksheets(1).Range("A1").Value = 10
src.Worksheets(1).Range("B2").Value = 20
src.Names.Add "Amount", "=Sheet1!$A$1"
src.Worksheets(1).Names.Add "LocalAmount", "=Sheet1!$A$1"
src.Worksheets(1).Range("B1").Formula = "=Amount+LocalAmount"
src.Worksheets(1).Copy After:=dst.Worksheets(1)
Report = CStr(dst.Worksheets.Count) & ":" & CStr(ActiveWorkbook Is dst) & "|"
For Each sh In dst.Worksheets
Report = Report & sh.Name & ":"
For Each cell In sh.Range("A1:D4")
If cell.Formula <> "" Then Report = Report & cell.Address & "=" & cell.Formula & ";"
Next cell
Report = Report & "|"
Next sh
For Each nm In dst.Names
Report = Report & nm.Name & "=" & nm.RefersTo & "|"
Next nm
